name: notarylive
description: Create online notarization orders with documents and signer details through NotaryLive.

interface.longDescription: Notarize your documents online with a remote notary using NotaryLive.com. Streamline the notarization process directly through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Help me get a document notarized online.
Can my document be notarized remotely?

review.commerce_description: Users purchase online notarization services from NotaryLive. Payment takes place on NotaryLive after the user follows the order link; this plugin does not collect payment in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Create an order from Markdown using a harmless test document. This test creates an order on the configured NotaryLive server.
positive.prompt:
Send the following document to NotaryLive with the title Test Statement. The signer placing the order is Demo Signer, mcp-test@notarylive.com.

Document begins:
# Test Statement
This is a test document.
Document ends.
positive.expected_behavior: Use document_markdown containing only the full text between the document boundary markers, excluding the markers themselves. Set document_title to Test Statement and include one signer, Demo Signer at mcp-test@notarylive.com. Present the exact link_to_order returned by the successful response as a clickable link. Explain that the user continues on NotaryLive to review the order, verify identity, pay, and meet a commissioned notary. Do not claim that payment or notarization has completed.

positive.description: Create an order from an uploaded PDF. Attach a harmless sample PDF before running. This test creates an order on the configured NotaryLive server.
positive.prompt: Send the attached PDF to NotaryLive with the title Test PDF. The signer placing the order is Demo Signer, mcp-test@notarylive.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Use document_file with the actual authorized attachment download URL, omit document_markdown, set document_title to Test PDF, and include one signer, Demo Signer at mcp-test@notarylive.com. Present the exact link_to_order returned by the successful response as a clickable link. Explain that the user continues on NotaryLive to review the order, verify identity, pay, and meet a commissioned notary. Do not claim that payment or notarization has completed.

positive.prompt:

positive.description: Create an order with supplied notary instructions using a harmless test document. This test creates an order on the configured NotaryLive server.
positive.prompt:
Send the following document to NotaryLive with the title Instructions Test. The signer placing the order is Demo Signer, mcp-test@notarylive.com. Include this instruction for the notary: This is a demonstration document.

Document begins:
# Instructions Test
This is a test.
Document ends.
positive.expected_behavior: Use document_markdown containing only the full text between the document boundary markers, excluding the markers themselves. Set document_title to Instructions Test, include one signer, Demo Signer at mcp-test@notarylive.com, and set notary_instructions to This is a demonstration document. Keep the notary instructions separate from the document content. Present the exact link_to_order returned by the successful response as a clickable link. Explain that the user continues on NotaryLive to review the order, verify identity, pay, and meet a commissioned notary. Do not claim that payment or notarization has completed.

negative.description: Explain that the plugin cannot notarize or apply a seal in chat; do not call create_notarization_order.
negative.prompt: Apply a notary seal to this document right here without a live notary.

negative.description: Explain that this plugin has no order-status lookup tool; do not create an order.
negative.prompt: Check the status of my existing NotaryLive order.

negative.description: Explain that this plugin has no cancellation or refund tool; do not create an order.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing NotaryLive order and refund my payment.
